Additional local evidence: accepted automation run, receipt and queue event commit together; four actual child-process exits and reopened SQLite verify history-only repair without dispatch. Restored profiles retain pending receipts and refuse activation until explicit resolution. This does not prove remote-event deduplication or provider outcome reconciliation. tests.coverageNote: Synthetic restore, local reference/content review and prior packaged Windows restore are evidenced. Current idle-profile manual activation requires fresh bound review and typed confirmation, rejects stale state and unresolved jobs/locks/process outcomes, remains paused until restart and keeps automatic services off. Targeted tests cover deferred later queued jobs and no automatic model diagnosis even with a configured test key. Supported resolution/rebind for blocked profiles, real user-profile drill and full code recovery remain unverified; current activation has not been rerun in packaged desktop. Explicit recovery cancellation now rejects ambiguous/started/locked records, binds current reviewed content and commits run/task/history/build/audit together without releasing locks. Versioned queued intent survives graceful close/reopen and recovered manual profiles remain paused until explicit scan. Full T36 status remains unchanged. Restored database/marker binding now rejects lost, exchanged or downgraded markers before startup; staged copied bytes are checksum-checked. Current unpacked Windows artifact passed synthetic restore/reopen, missing-marker refusal with exit code 1 and unchanged database bytes, and legacy credential/profile migration. Full activation, real user-profile and installer/update acceptance remain unverified. Additional local evidence: accepted automation run, receipt and queue event commit together; four actual child-process exits and reopened SQLite verify history-only repair without dispatch. Restored profiles retain pending receipts and refuse activation until explicit resolution. This does not prove remote-event deduplication or provider outcome reconciliation. Explicit typed/content-bound restored receipt review now projects history or acknowledges a missing definition without changing runs/locks. Audit failure retains the pending receipt after JSON projection and requires fresh review before retry; newer or ambiguous history stays blocked. This does not certify the real-profile drill. Today preference storage now has local API evidence for restart/profile isolation, stale-write refusal, rollback after injected commit denial and corrupt JSON preservation. Migration 0020 native packaged upgrade/restore is not certified.
